_comment: Example Claude Desktop MCP registration for the NullShadow MCP server (Phase 4). Copy the 'nullshadow' entry into your Claude Desktop config file: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json, Windows %APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json. Update the absolute paths to match your install, then fully restart Claude Desktop. Prefer the venv python (./venv/bin/python) so the 'mcp' package is available.
